title: Oozing Tunisian Prawns Tagine
description: A silky, comforting tagine bursting with fresh king prawns and aromatic spices, served in a rich tomato‑based sauce that stays moist and flavorful.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat and sauté the diced onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for one minute until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste and the spice blend, cooking until the paste darkens and aromas release.
Pour in the chicken stock, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add the prawns, cover, and let them cook for 4-5 minutes until they turn pink and opaque.
Stir in the lemon juice, salt, and pepper to taste, ensuring the sauce remains silky.
Fold in the chopped fresh herbs and remove from heat.
Serve the tagine hot over couscous or crusty bread, letting the sauce ooze.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
